entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you with the next available agent.
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return something.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I want to return a VeloBand Pulse I bought a couple of weeks ago. It's just not working out for me.
I understand. Can you please provide your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
Thank you. I've located your order. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse on [date 15 days ago]. What seems to be the issue with the smart watch?
It's not tracking my heart rate accurately, the battery life is terrible, and honestly, it's just not what I expected. I want to return it.
I apologize that the VeloBand Pulse isn't meeting your expectations. Our return policy is designed to ensure your satisfaction. You're within the window for a return.
How long do I have? I've had it a little over two weeks, and this whole thing has been a hassle. This VeloBand Pulse is faulty!
Our standard return policy is 90 days, so you're well within that timeframe. We can definitely process a return for you.
90 days? Okay, good. I was worried there for a second. The device is basically unusable! What do I need to do?

I can email you a prepaid shipping label. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse securely in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it off at any [shipping carrier] location. Once we receive the returned item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
That sounds easy enough. When will I get the label?

I'll send it to [customer email address] right now. It should arrive in your inbox within a few minutes. Please check your spam folder just in case. Also, just as an FYI, the return policy ensures you have enough time to test out new products.
Okay, I see it. Thanks for your help. I appreciate you not giving me a hard time about this. I thought I was going to have to speak with a manager to get this done.
You're very welcome. We strive to make the return process as seamless as possible. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's all. Thanks again!
You're very welcome. Have a great day!
